title: Bringing East Asian Investors to Cardano

ms.promise:
・Connect with a key community builder in each of the four targeted Asian countries.
・Collaboratively define a tailored outreach strategy with each community builder specific to their country’s context.
・Create a set of content pieces targeted for each specific country, informed by the collaborative strategies
ms.criteria:
・Writen agreements or documented commitments from each community builder.
・A documented outreach strategy co-created with each community builder, approved by our team.
・A minimum of eight content pieces, each aligned with the defined outreach strategies and approved by our content team. Content pieces will be flyers to invite people to the events and educational material created specifically for the country in their native language. Content will be posted in several community channels like: X, Linkedin, Facebook, Discord, Telegram & more.

ms.promise:
・Conduct at least 8 investor onboarding sessions, including webinars, information sessions, and AMAs, in collaboration with community builders.
・Quantifiable engagement metrics report such as attendee numbers, session impressions, and Feedback on the event.
ms.criteria:
・ Each session must be executed as per the planned schedule with participation of the intended community builders.
・Metrics report showcasing attendance figures, engagement levels, and other relevant statistics. Collection of participant feedback reflecting the effectiveness of the sessions.

ms.promise:
・Close-Out Report, inlcuding a thorough analysis of the outreach campaign, focusing on key metrics and overall impact.
・Close-Out VIdeo that encapsulates the campaign's journey, key milestones, and testimonials from community builders and participants.
ms.criteria:
・A comprehensive report detailing performance metrics, effectiveness of engagement strategies, and lessons learned during the proposal's execution. 
・The close-out video must effectively summarize the campaign, capturing key initiatives, stakeholder engagements, and notable outcomes.. The duration of the video should be appropriate to cover the breadth of the campaign while remaining engaging (1-3 Minutes) The video should be of professional quality, with clear audio and visuals, suitable for distribution across various platforms including social media and the Cardano community channels.
